nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.intent: 交代背景：花果山之巅有一块仙石，日夜吞吐日月精华，渐渐有了灵性。营造神话开场氛围。

fallback_text.en: High on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit stood a magic stone. Day and night, it drank in the light of the sun and the moon.
fallback_text.zh: 花果山之巅立着一块仙石，日夜吞吐着日月精华。

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.intent: 仙石迸裂，蹦出一只石猴，双目金光直冲云霄，惊动天地。节奏要快，有爆破感。

fallback_text.en: One day — CRACK! The stone split open, and a little stone monkey leaped out. Golden light flashed from his eyes, straight up to the sky.
fallback_text.zh: 忽一日——砰！仙石迸裂，蹦出一只小石猴。他目运金光，直冲云霄。

nodes.speaker: elder_monkey
nodes.intent: 老猴看见石猴出世，又惊又喜，大声惊呼并招呼群猴围观。

fallback_text.en: Look! A baby monkey — born from stone! Oh my, oh my! Come and see!
fallback_text.zh: 快看！石缝里蹦出一只小猴！哎呀呀，大家快来看！

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.intent: 群猴朝拜石猴；镜头交给玩家——你就是这只石猴，整个世界对你都是新的。

fallback_text.en: The monkeys bowed to the strange newborn. And you — yes, YOU are that stone monkey. The whole mountain is new to you.
fallback_text.zh: 群猴向这只奇石所生的猴儿俯首。而你——就是那只石猴。这整座山，对你来说都是新的。

nodes.speaker: you
nodes.intent: 瀑布声如雷，玩家决定先做什么。三个行动选项：径直走向瀑布 / 询问老猴 / 绕山观察。

fallback_text.en: A waterfall thunders nearby, pouring into the valley. What will you do?
fallback_text.zh: 不远处瀑布轰鸣，直泻深涧。你要做什么？

text.en: Ask Old Monkey about the roar.
text.zh: 去问老猴，这轰鸣是什么。

text.en: Climb around the mountain and look around first.
text.zh: 先绕着山转一转，观察四周。

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.intent: 玩家选了直面路线：径直走到瀑布前，水声如鼓、水雾扑面，但石猴毫不退缩。体现胆气。

fallback_text.en: You walk right up to the falls. The water crashes like drums. Mist sprays your face — but you do not step back.
fallback_text.zh: 你径直走到瀑布跟前。水声如鼓，水雾扑面——你半步不退。

nodes.speaker: elder_monkey
nodes.intent: 玩家选择询问：老猴讲传说——那是水帘，帘子后头似乎藏着东西，但水势凶猛，从没有猴敢进去。

fallback_text.en: That roar? That is the Water Curtain! They say something hides behind it... But the water is fierce. No monkey has ever dared to go in.
fallback_text.zh: 那轰鸣？那是水帘！听说帘子后头藏着东西……可水势太凶，从来没有猴敢进去。

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.intent: 玩家选择观察：绕山一圈，发现瀑布边垂着藤蔓，水帘起落之间有一线间隙——把这条线索记在心里。

fallback_text.en: You circle the mountain. Vines hang down beside the falls. And look — the water curtain rises and falls. For a breath, there is a gap.
fallback_text.zh: 你绕山一圈，看见瀑布边垂着藤蔓。再看——水帘起起落落之间，似乎有一线间隙。

nodes.speaker: elder_monkey
nodes.intent: 老猴当众立约：谁敢钻进瀑布再平安出来，就拜谁为王。要念得庄重、有仪式感。

fallback_text.en: Monkeys! Let us make a promise! Whoever can go through the waterfall and come back safe — we will make him KING!
fallback_text.zh: 猴儿们！我们立个约定！哪个敢钻进瀑布、还能平安出来——我们就拜他为王！

nodes.speaker: you
nodes.intent: 决断时刻。基础选项：闭目纵身跳入 / 退后观察水势；若此前见过藤蔓（saw_vines），额外出现借藤蔓寻隙的稳妥选项。

fallback_text.en: The water roars. The monkeys hold their breath. This is the moment.
fallback_text.zh: 水声轰鸣，群猴屏息。就是此刻了。

text.en: Shut your eyes and leap into the falls!
text.zh: 闭目蹲身，纵身跳入瀑布！

text.en: Step back and watch the water first.
Use the vines — wait beside the falls for a gap.
text.zh: 借藤蔓到瀑布侧面，等水帘露隙。

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.intent: 勇者路线：闭目蹲身纵身一跃，飞流接住石猴，把他裹进水帘。

fallback_text.en: Eyes shut, body low — you leap! The falling water catches you and pulls you through.
fallback_text.zh: 你闭目蹲身，纵身一跃！飞流接住你，把你裹了进去。

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.intent: 谨慎路线：玩家数着水帘起落的节奏，看准间隙跳入。

fallback_text.en: You watch the curtain rise... and fall... NOW! You leap through the gap.
fallback_text.zh: 你看准水帘起落的节奏——就是现在！你从间隙跃了进去。

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.intent: 机敏路线：借藤蔓荡到瀑布侧面，从水薄处钻入，稳稳当当。体现观察的回报。

fallback_text.en: Swing on the vines, slip in where the water is thin — smooth as silk. In you go!
fallback_text.zh: 你荡着藤蔓，从水薄处一钻——稳稳当当，进去了！

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.intent: 睁眼所见：一座石桥、石锅石灶石碗石盆、桥下泉水叮咚——真的是好地方。惊喜感。

fallback_text.en: You open your eyes. A stone bridge! Pots and bowls of stone! A spring sings under the bridge. What a wonderful place!
fallback_text.zh: 你睁开眼——一座石桥！石锅、石灶、石碗、石盆！桥下泉水叮咚。真是个好地方！

nodes.speaker: you
nodes.intent: 石猴发现石碣上有刻字，既好奇又兴奋，迫不及待。

fallback_text.en: On a stone pillar, there are carved words! Words! You cannot wait to read them.
fallback_text.zh: 石碣上刻着一行字！你迫不及待要念出来。

text.en: Read the carved words out loud.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.intent: 石碣铭文：花果山福地，水帘洞洞天。石猴一字一句念出，铿锵响亮。

fallback_text.en: 'Flower-Fruit Mountain, a blessed land. Water-Curtain Cave, a cave of heaven.' You read every word loud and clear!
fallback_text.zh: 「花果山福地，水帘洞洞天。」你一字一句，念得铿锵响亮！

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.intent: 先逛洞的收获：石桌石凳，一线清泉从洞中流过，取水正好方便。

fallback_text.en: Stone tables! Stone seats! And a thin, clear spring flows right through the cave — perfect for drinking.
fallback_text.zh: 石桌！石凳！还有一线清泉从洞中流过——取水正方便。

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.intent: 石猴纵身跳出瀑布，稳稳落在群猴面前，毫发无伤。

fallback_text.en: You leap back out through the curtain and land in front of all the monkeys. Safe and sound!
fallback_text.zh: 你纵身跳出瀑布，稳稳落在群猴面前，毫发无伤！

nodes.speaker: elder_monkey
nodes.intent: 老猴兑现承诺，率群猴拜石猴为王。全场欢呼的高潮。

fallback_text.en: He went in AND came out! A promise is a promise! All hail the Stone Monkey — our king!
fallback_text.zh: 他进得来，出得去！说话算话！拜石猴为王！拜王喽——

nodes.speaker: system
nodes.intent: 章节结束卡：宣布石猴成为美猴王，引导查看本章小结。

fallback_text.en: From this day on, you are the Handsome Monkey King of the Water-Curtain Cave!
fallback_text.zh: 从这一天起，你就是水帘洞的美猴王！
